datasets.name: table_inventory
queryLines:
SELECT
  table_schema,
  table_name,
  table_type,
  CASE
    WHEN table_schema = 'staging' THEN '1-Staging'
    WHEN table_schema = 'raw_vault' THEN '2-Raw Vault'
    WHEN table_schema = 'business_vault' THEN '3-Business Vault'
    WHEN table_schema = 'marts' THEN '4-Marts'
  END as layer,
  CASE
    WHEN table_name LIKE 'stg_%' THEN 'Staging Table'
    WHEN table_name LIKE 'hub_%' THEN 'Hub'
    WHEN table_name LIKE 'lnk_%' THEN 'Link'
    WHEN table_name LIKE 'sat_%' THEN 'Satellite'
    WHEN table_name LIKE 'pit_%' THEN 'PIT'
    WHEN table_name LIKE 'bridge_%' THEN 'Bridge'
    WHEN table_name LIKE 'ref_%' THEN 'Reference'
    WHEN table_name LIKE 'dim_%' THEN 'Dimension'
    WHEN table_name LIKE 'fact_%' THEN 'Fact'
    WHEN table_name LIKE 'agg_%' THEN 'Aggregate'
    WHEN table_name LIKE 'feat_%' THEN 'Feature'
    WHEN table_name LIKE '%_metrics' THEN 'Metric View'
    WHEN table_name = 'reviews_tracked_dv' THEN 'CDC Tracking'
    ELSE 'Other'
  END as entity_type
FROM
  restaurant_chain_db.information_schema.tables
WHERE
  table_schema IN ('staging', 'raw_vault', 'business_vault', 'marts')
  AND table_name NOT LIKE '__materialization%'
  AND table_name NOT LIKE 'event_log%'
ORDER BY
  layer,
  entity_type,
  table_name

datasets.name: entity_breakdown
queryLines:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN table_name LIKE 'stg_%' THEN 'Staging Table'
    WHEN table_name LIKE 'hub_%' THEN 'Hub'
    WHEN table_name LIKE 'lnk_%' THEN 'Link'
    WHEN table_name LIKE 'sat_%' THEN 'Satellite'
    WHEN table_name LIKE 'pit_%' THEN 'PIT'
    WHEN table_name LIKE 'bridge_%' THEN 'Bridge'
    WHEN table_name LIKE 'ref_%' THEN 'Reference'
    WHEN table_name LIKE 'dim_%' THEN 'Dimension'
    WHEN table_name LIKE 'fact_%' THEN 'Fact'
    WHEN table_name LIKE 'agg_%' THEN 'Aggregate'
    WHEN table_name LIKE 'feat_%' THEN 'Feature'
    WHEN table_name LIKE '%_metrics' THEN 'Metric View'
    WHEN table_name = 'reviews_tracked_dv' THEN 'CDC Tracking'
    ELSE 'Other'
  END as entity_type,
  COUNT(*) as table_count
FROM
  restaurant_chain_db.information_schema.tables
WHERE
  table_schema IN ('staging', 'raw_vault', 'business_vault', 'marts')
  AND table_name NOT LIKE '__materialization%'
  AND table_name NOT LIKE 'event_log%'
GROUP BY
  1
ORDER BY
  table_count DESC

datasets.name: layer_summary
queryLines:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN table_schema = 'staging' THEN '1-Staging'
    WHEN table_schema = 'raw_vault' THEN '2-Raw Vault'
    WHEN table_schema = 'business_vault' THEN '3-Business Vault'
    WHEN table_schema = 'marts' THEN '4-Marts'
  END as layer,
  COUNT(*) as table_count,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN table_type = 'MATERIALIZED_VIEW' THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) as materialized_views,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN table_type = 'STREAMING_TABLE' THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) as streaming_tables,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN table_type = 'METRIC_VIEW' THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) as metric_views
FROM
  restaurant_chain_db.information_schema.tables
WHERE
  table_schema IN ('staging', 'raw_vault', 'business_vault', 'marts')
  AND table_name NOT LIKE '__materialization%'
  AND table_name NOT LIKE 'event_log%'
GROUP BY
  table_schema
ORDER BY
  layer
